research_rationale:
Complete official original and full EO9830 PartsI–III were read and operative primary pages inspected. EO9830 opening makes the entire order effective May1,1947; PartIII expressly names the target and PartII restates the Civil Service Rules. The selected end is the named-target endpoint under the owner October21 unnamed-instruments ruling, not a finding that all substantive host-rule application stayed unchanged earlier. No own sunset, completed single assignment or independent original command survives outside the corrected inventory. Earlier unnamed host changes and savings are separately pinned in source_notes; no exact effective date is invented for qualified administrative candidates. The native original evidence is the actual FR representation; uncited derivative working-text leads receive no confirmation. These are earlier partial-scope unnamedcandidates, not named8707ends. VPA1944§13supplies independentpreference-eligiblereinstatement;§18saves priorpersonalrights. The initial February-published Part27§27.9(a)(1) used completed probation/absolute appointment; the April amendment expressly effective March7,1946 adds(a)(6) probation-separated reinstatement within same agency/type/grade/locality, one year with preference waiver, to complete probation, without a six-month minimum, plus the separate(d) six-month-total-service war-service conversion route. These versions and the later July certificate amendment must be distinguished; no blanket completed-probation requirement for the whole1946interval is asserted. §27.10allows absoluteappointment or sixprobationarymonths with completion oforiginalprobation plusstatus/qualifications/releaseconditions. §27.16(f,g)protectspendingprobation/status/tenure andRuleIXequivalentbenefits. These are bounded checks through cutoff, not universal-negative or human certification.  Fresh packet v9 explicitly reaffirms the same original inventory, original/page confirmations, selected sources, dates and member judgments against their unchanged held bytes; old producer approval is not inherited as an independent review. Correction after independent source examination: the prior proposal omitted the April 1946 version of temporary reinstatement regulation §27.9. The February published §27.9(a)(1) used completed probation or absolute appointment. The April2 Commission instrument, filed April12 and published April16 at11FR4143/4145, expressly effective March7,1946, adds an exception for(a)(6). That exception permits reinstatement after separation during probation only in the same agency, type of position, grade and locality, within one year except for preference eligibles, to complete probation. It has no six-month service minimum. Separately, revised(d) permits conversion of war-service indefinite appointments after separation of30days or more from probational, probational-indefinite or permanent appointments, with six months total satisfactory service, at agency discretion without Commission prior approval, subject to report and post-audit. These provisions must not be merged. They differ from8707 broad any-part-of-service reinstatement after six satisfactory months in a long-probation position. The amendment is retroactive to March7; no finding is made that the initial February completed-probation condition remained unqualified throughout March–July. July§27.9(b)(3) modifies the intervening April certificate version. The explicit date establishes revised§27.9 timing, not every other Part27 section effective date. April does not name8707, so the owner convention retains May1,1947 as its named endpoint. Successor rules granting completion of probation do not by themselves preserve or revive8707authority.

The February published §27.9(a)(1) used completed probation or absolute appointment. The April2 Commission instrument, filed April12 and published April16 at11FR4143/4145, expressly effective March7,1946, adds an exception for(a)(6). That exception permits reinstatement after separation during probation only in the same agency, type of position, grade and locality, within one year except for preference eligibles, to complete probation. It has no six-month service minimum. Separately, revised(d) permits conversion of war-service indefinite appointments after separation of30days or more from probational, probational-indefinite or permanent appointments, with six months total satisfactory service, at agency discretion without Commission prior approval, subject to report and post-audit. These provisions must not be merged. They differ from8707 broad any-part-of-service reinstatement after six satisfactory months in a long-probation position. The amendment is retroactive to March7; no finding is made that the initial February completed-probation condition remained unqualified throughout March–July.
